steps.name: environment: install/validate OpenJDK and Android cmdline-tools idempotently
steps.description: Ensure OpenJDK 11+ is available (install only if absent), install minimal unzip if missing, download Android SDK command-line tools into /opt/android-sdk in the expected cmdline-tools/latest layout if missing, persist CI and Android SDK environment variables into /etc/profile.d/react_native_env.sh (preserving unexpanded $PATH) and optionally install minimal SDK platform/build-tools when INSTALL_ANDROID_SDK_PACKAGES=true. Avoid reinstalling preinstalled tools and validate final tool availability.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/ride-booking-manager-220478-220487/mobile_native_app"
SDK_ROOT="/opt/android-sdk"
CMDLINE_URL="https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-9477386_latest.zip"
REQUIRED_MAJOR=11
# Install only missing helper packages (do not reinstall preinstalled tools)
need_unzip=0
if ! command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then need_unzip=1; fi
if [ "$need_unzip" -eq 1 ]; then sudo apt-get update -q && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -q unzip >/dev/null; fi
# Java detection and conditional install
JAVA_VER_STR="$(java -XshowSettings:properties -version 2>&1 | awk -F= '/java.version/ {print $2}' | tr -d '"' || true)"
echo "JAVA_VERSION=${JAVA_VER_STR:-none}" >&2
JAVA_MAJOR=0
if [ -n "$JAVA_VER_STR" ]; then
  if [[ "$JAVA_VER_STR" == 1.* ]]; then
    JAVA_MAJOR=$(echo "$JAVA_VER_STR" | awk -F. '{print $2}')
  else
    JAVA_MAJOR=$(echo "$JAVA_VER_STR" | awk -F. '{print $1}')
  fi
fi
if [ "$JAVA_MAJOR" -lt $REQUIRED_MAJOR ]; then
  sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -q && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -q openjdk-11-jdk >/dev/null
fi
# Determine JAVA_HOME robustly: prefer /usr/lib/jvm/* matching java binary or fallback
if command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  java_path=$(readlink -f "$(command -v java)")
  # look for candidate under /usr/lib/jvm
  cand=$(dirname "$(dirname "$java_path")")
  if [ -d "$cand" ] && grep -q '/jre\|/bin' <<<"$cand" 2>/dev/null; then
    # prefer a /usr/lib/jvm path if available
    if [[ "$cand" == /usr/lib/jvm/* ]]; then
      JAVA_HOME_FINAL="$cand"
    else
      # try to find an installed jvm that matches
      JVM_CAND=$(ls -d /usr/lib/jvm/java-* 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
      JAVA_HOME_FINAL="${JVM_CAND:-/usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk-amd64}"
    fi
  else
    JVM_CAND=$(ls -d /usr/lib/jvm/java-* 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
    JAVA_HOME_FINAL="${JVM_CAND:-/usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk-amd64}"
  fi
else
  echo 'ERROR: java not found after install' >&2; exit 2
fi
# Install Android cmdline-tools if missing
SDKMANAGER_PATH="$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER_PATH" ]; then
  sudo mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT" && sudo chmod 0755 "$SDK_ROOT"
  TMPZIP=$(mktemp --suffix=.zip)
  tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
  curl -fSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 "$CMDLINE_URL" -o "$TMPZIP"
  unzip -q "$TMPZIP" -d "$tmpdir"
  # Find the extracted cmdline-tools directory and move only that subtree
  extracted=$(find "$tmpdir" -maxdepth 2 -type d -name "cmdline-tools" -print -quit || true)
  sudo mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools"
  sudo rm -rf "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest"
  if [ -n "$extracted" ]; then
    # move the inner 'cmdline-tools' children into latest
    sudo mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest"
    # some zips contain a 'cmdline-tools' dir with a subdir, move its children
    for d in "$extracted"/*; do
      sudo mv "$d" "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/" 2>/dev/null || true
    done
  else
    # fallback: if zip placed bin directly, move its contents
    sudo mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest"
    sudo mv "$tmpdir"/* "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  rm -rf "$TMPZIP" "$tmpdir"
  sudo chmod -R a+rX "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest" || true
fi
# Optionally install minimal SDK packages when requested
if [ "${INSTALL_ANDROID_SDK_PACKAGES:-false}" = "true" ]; then
  if [ -x "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" ]; then
    sudo mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT/platforms" "$SDK_ROOT/build-tools" || true
    yes | sudo "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" --sdk_root="${SDK_ROOT}" "platform-tools" "platforms;android-33" "build-tools;33.0.2" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  else
    echo 'WARN: sdkmanager not available; cannot install SDK packages' >&2
  fi
fi
# Write profile idempotently, preserving unexpanded $PATH token
ENV_FILE="/etc/profile.d/react_native_env.sh"
read -r -d '' NEW_ENV <<'EOF'
export JAVA_HOME="__JAVA_HOME__"
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="/opt/android-sdk"
export ANDROID_HOME="/opt/android-sdk"
export PATH="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/platform-tools:
\$PATH"
export CI=true
export NODE_ENV=development
EOF
NEW_ENV=${NEW_ENV//__JAVA_HOME__/$JAVA_HOME_FINAL}
# write only if different
if [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
  if ! sudo bash -c "cmp -s /dev/stdin '$ENV_FILE'" <<<"$NEW_ENV"; then
    printf '%s' "$NEW_ENV" | sudo tee "$ENV_FILE" >/dev/null
    sudo chmod 644 "$ENV_FILE"
  fi
else
  printf '%s' "$NEW_ENV" | sudo tee "$ENV_FILE" >/dev/null
  sudo chmod 644 "$ENV_FILE"
fi
# Validate availability
command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'ERROR: Java missing' >&2; exit 3; }
if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER_PATH" ]; then
  echo 'WARN: sdkmanager not installed or not executable; Android builds will be skipped unless SDK packages are installed' >&2
fi
# export for current shell
export JAVA_HOME="$JAVA_HOME_FINAL" ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$SDK_ROOT" ANDROID_HOME="$SDK_ROOT"
export PATH="$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$SDK_ROOT/platform-tools:$PATH"

steps.name: scaffolding: initialize React Native project with npx and add start scripts
steps.description: If workspace lacks package.json, run 'npx react-native init' in a temp directory and copy the generated project into the workspace using rsync to avoid dotfile '.'/'..' issues. Preserve lockfiles, update package.json scripts safely using Node, and create a lightweight file-based mock config. Fail loudly on scaffold errors to aid autonomous execution.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/ride-booking-manager-220478-220487/mobile_native_app"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" && cd "$WORKSPACE"
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
  # run npx react-native init in tempdir; do not suppress stderr
  npx react-native init temp_mobile_app --npm --directory "$tmpdir" || { rc=$?; rm -rf "$tmpdir"; echo 'ERROR: react-native init failed' >&2; exit $rc; }
  # detect generated path
  if [ -d "$tmpdir/temp_mobile_app" ]; then
    src="$tmpdir/temp_mobile_app/"
  else
    src="$tmpdir/"
  fi
  # copy safely with rsync to preserve permissions and avoid '.'/'..' expansion
  command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo apt-get update -q && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -q rsync >/dev/null
  rsync -a --exclude='node_modules' "$src" "$WORKSPACE/" || { echo 'ERROR: rsync copy failed' >&2; rm -rf "$tmpdir"; exit 5; }
  rm -rf "$tmpdir"
fi
[ -f "$WORKSPACE/package.json" ] || { echo 'ERROR: package.json missing after scaffold' >&2; exit 2; }
# Safely add scripts using node; preserve existing scripts
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));p.scripts=p.scripts||{};if(!p.scripts.start)p.scripts.start='react-native start';if(!p.scripts.android)p.scripts.android='react-native run-android --no-packager';fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/mocks" && cat > "$WORKSPACE/mocks/mock-config.json" <<'JSON'
{ "useMock": true, "mockServer": "file" }
JSON

steps.name: dependencies: install JavaScript dependencies respecting lockfiles and versions
steps.description: Install project dependencies non-interactively. Prefer yarn when yarn.lock exists and yarn is available; prefer npm ci when package-lock.json exists. Validate Node/npm/yarn versions and warn if incompatible with typical React Native requirements. If package.json has been modified by scaffold or test steps, reconcile by re-running the package manager to update node_modules and lockfiles.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/ride-booking-manager-220478-220487/mobile_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
[ -f package.json ] || { echo 'ERROR: package.json missing; run scaffold first' >&2; exit 2; }
# Print versions and warn if Node <16 (common RN reqs may vary)
node_v=$(node -v 2>/dev/null || echo "none")
npm_v=$(npm -v 2>/dev/null || echo "none")
echo "NODE=$node_v NPM=$npm_v" >&2
if [[ "$node_v" != none ]]; then
  vnum=${node_v#v}
  maj=${vnum%%.*}
  if [ "$maj" -lt 16 ]; then
    echo 'WARN: Node major version <16 may be incompatible with some React Native templates' >&2
  fi
fi
# Choose installer based on lockfiles and availability
if [ -f yarn.lock ] && command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  yarn --network-timeout 60000 --silent --non-interactive || { echo 'ERROR: yarn install failed' >&2; exit 3; }
elif [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline --silent || { echo 'ERROR: npm ci failed' >&2; exit 4; }
else
  if command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    yarn --network-timeout 60000 --silent --non-interactive || { echo 'ERROR: yarn install failed' >&2; exit 3; }
  else
    npm i --no-audit --no-fund --silent || { echo 'ERROR: npm install failed' >&2; exit 4; }
  fi
fi
# If android/gradlew missing, warn (do not install system gradle)
if [ -d android ] && [ ! -f android/gradlew ]; then
  echo 'WARN: android/gradlew not present. APK build will be skipped in validation unless gradlew is added.' >&2
fi

Create a simple dummy test and run tests preferring local jest binary, falling back to global jest or npx jest. Fail loudly on test failures and provide logs.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/ride-booking-manager-220478-220487/mobile_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
[ -f package.json ] || { echo 'ERROR: package.json missing; run scaffold first' >&2; exit 2; }
# Detect package manager
PKG_MANAGER="npm"
if [ -f yarn.lock ] && command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then PKG_MANAGER="yarn"; fi
# Check if jest listed in package.json
has_jest=$(node -e "const p=require('./package.json');console.log((p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies.jest)||(p.dependencies&&p.dependencies.jest)?1:0)" || echo 0)
if [ "$has_jest" -ne 1 ]; then
  if [ "$PKG_MANAGER" = "yarn" ]; then
    yarn add --dev --silent jest@^29.0.0 || { echo 'ERROR: yarn add jest failed' >&2; exit 3; }
    yarn --silent --non-interactive || true
  else
    npm i --save-dev --no-audit --no-fund --silent jest@^29.0.0 || { echo 'ERROR: npm add jest failed' >&2; exit 4; }
    npm i --silent --no-audit --no-fund || true
  fi
fi
# Ensure minimal jest config file exists
if [ ! -f jest.config.js ]; then
  cat > jest.config.js <<'JCFG'
module.exports = { preset: 'react-native' };
JCFG
fi
# Ensure package.json has jest preset if missing
has_jest_config=$(node -e "const p=require('./package.json');console.log(p.jest?1:0)" || echo 0)
if [ "$has_jest_config" -ne 1 ]; then
  node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('./package.json');p.jest=p.jest||{};p.jest.preset=p.jest.preset||'react-native';fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2))"
  # reconcile dependencies after package.json change
  if [ "$PKG_MANAGER" = "yarn" ]; then
    yarn --silent --non-interactive || true
  else
    npm i --silent --no-audit --no-fund || true
  fi
fi
mkdir -p __tests__ && cat > __tests__/dummy.test.js <<'JS'
test('dummy', () => expect(1+1).toBe(2));
JS
# Prefer local jest binary
if [ -x "node_modules/.bin/jest" ]; then
  ./node_modules/.bin/jest --colors --runInBand || { echo 'ERROR: jest (local) failed' >&2; exit 5; }
elif command -v jest >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  jest --colors --runInBand || { echo 'ERROR: jest (global) failed' >&2; exit 6; }
else
  # fallback to npx which will install if missing
  npx jest --colors --runInBand || { echo 'ERROR: npx jest failed' >&2; exit 7; }
fi

steps.name: validation: start Metro, optionally build APK, emit JSON evidence
steps.description: Start Metro bundler in background, poll for readiness via HTTP and improved log heuristics, ensure cleanup via trap (kill process and process group), optionally accept SDK licenses and run ./gradlew assembleDebug when SDK platforms/build-tools and android/gradlew exist. Emit JSON evidence of metro readiness and APK existence. Avoid fragile setsid usage and ensure robust PGID-based cleanup.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/ride-booking-manager-220478-220487/mobile_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
export CI=true NODE_ENV=development
LOG=/tmp/metro.log
# Start metro in background and capture PID and PGID
npx react-native start --port 8081 >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
METRO_PID=$!
# give it a moment
sleep 1
# get process group id for cleanup (may be same as pid)
METRO_PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$METRO_PID" | tr -d ' ' || echo "$METRO_PID")
cleanup() {
  if ps -p "$METRO_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    kill -TERM "$METRO_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  if [ -n "$METRO_PGID" ]; then
    kill -TERM -"$METRO_PGID" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  wait "$METRO_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT
# Poll for readiness up to 60s
RETRIES=60
READY=0
for i in $(seq 1 $RETRIES); do
  http_code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8081/status || true)
  if [ "$http_code" = "200" ]; then READY=1; break; fi
  # fallback: look for 'bundle' or 'Running Metro' messages in log
  if grep -Ei "metro ready|running.*metro|bundle.*asset" "$LOG" 2>/dev/null | grep -qi .; then READY=1; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo 'ERROR: Metro failed to become ready; tailing log' >&2
  tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2 || true
  exit 2
fi
APK_PATH="$WORKSPACE/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk"
APK_BUILT=false
# Attempt APK build only if android/gradlew exists and SDK packages present
if [ -d android ] && [ -f android/gradlew ]; then
  if [ -d "/opt/android-sdk/platforms" ] && [ -d "/opt/android-sdk/build-tools" ]; then
    if [ -x "/opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" ]; then
      yes | /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --licenses --sdk_root="/opt/android-sdk" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    fi
    (cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon -q) || { echo 'ERROR: gradle assembleDebug failed' >&2; exit 3; }
    [ -f "$APK_PATH" ] && APK_BUILT=true
  else
    echo 'INFO: Android SDK platforms/build-tools missing; skipping APK build' >&2
  fi
fi
# cleanup will run via trap
# Emit JSON evidence
apk_json=false
if [ "$APK_BUILT" = true ]; then apk_json=true; fi
printf '{"metro_status":"ok","apk_exists":%s}\n' "$apk_json"
